about_the_game:
Internal Incident is a hardcore extraction shooter with survival horror elements.  Navigate nightmare facilities that change with every deployment, managing ammo, batteries, and sanity as you piece together what caused the catastrophe. Play solo or in tense 4-player co-op, where every decision could be your last.

Key Features:

  • Procedurally Generated – The facility changes every time you enter. Corridors shift, rooms rearrange, and dangers move. You’ll never know what’s waiting for you.

  • Resource Management – Light, ammo, and medical supplies are scarce. Every bullet counts, and the darkness is not your friend.

  • Permanent Consequences – Death means losing everything. Only successful extractions let you keep gear and progress further.

  • Risk vs. Reward – The most valuable secrets are hidden in the most dangerous areas. Will you play it safe or push deeper for bigger prizes?

  • Solo or Squad Survival – Go in alone or team up with up to 3 others—but remember, resources are limited, and not everyone will make it out.

  • Uncover the Truth – Find hidden documents, audio logs, and strange clues to uncover what really happened here… if you survive long enough.

Warning: The complex does not forgive mistakes. Will you take the risk?

content_descriptors.notes: The game features horror elements, including violence, blood, disturbing creatures, darkness, and jump scares.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for better loading times. These system requirements are preliminary and may be updated closer to the game's Early Access release.

short_description: A survival horror extraction shooter set in procedurally generated underground facilities. Manage limited resources, navigate oppressive darkness, and take deadly risks to claim precious rewards. Each descent reveals fragments of a lost world buried in the shadows.
